recipe.build:
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/^\s*flutter:\s\^?([0-9.]+)\s*$/\1/p' pubspec.yaml)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-v8a-release*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk

mv ${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/android-ndk-r${PROVISIONING_CACHE_ANDROID_NDK_VERSION:0:2}? ${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/${PROVISIONING_CACHE_ANDROID_NDK_VERSION}

NDK_VERSION="(yq -r '.package.metadata.android.ndk-version' engine/Cargo.toml)"

NDK_VERSION="27.0.12077973"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
sdkmanager --install "ndk;${NDK_VERSION}"
pushd engine
cargo install cargo-ndk --version $CARGO_NDK_VERSION --locked
export ANDROID_NDK_HOME=$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/${NDK_VERSION}

popd

flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi

recipe.build:
mkdir -p ${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk
unzip -q "${PROVISIONING_CACHE_ANDROID_NDK_PATH}" -d ${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk
mv ${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/android-ndk-r${PROVISIONING_CACHE_ANDROID_NDK_VERSION:0:2}? ${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/${PROVISIONING_CACHE_ANDROID_NDK_VERSION}
export ANDROID_NDK=${ANDROID_HOME}/ndk/${PROVISIONING_CACHE_ANDROID_NDK_VERSION}
FLUTTER_VERSION="$(yq -r '.environment.flutter' pubspec.yaml)"
CARGO_NDK_VERSION="$(sed -rn 's/cargo-ndk-version = .([0-9.]+).*/\1/p' engine/Cargo.toml)"
git clone -b $FLUTTER_VERSION https://github.com/flutter/flutter
pushd engine
cargo install cargo-ndk --version $CARGO_NDK_VERSION --locked
export ANDROID_NDK_HOME=$ANDROID_NDK
cargo ndk -t arm64-v8a -o ../android/app/src/main/jniLibs build --release --locked
popd
export PUB_CACHE=$(pwd)/.pub-cache
flutter/bin/flutter config --no-analytics
flutter/bin/flutter pub get
sed -i -e 's/-Wl,/-Wl,--build-id=none,/' ${PUB_CACHE}/hosted/*/jni-*/src/CMakeLists.txt
flutter/bin/flutter build apk --release --split-per-abi
find . -name '*.apk'
mv build/app/outputs/flutter-apk/app-arm64-v8a-release*.apk /outputs/unsigned.apk
